[spoiler=The Final Daze (Yes I Spell out Daze not Days)][b][u][i]July 13, 2026[/i][/u][/b]

[b][i]15:00[/i][/b]

The way they saw it, there was nothing but carnage, drones had caused buildings to collapse and both Guhui'Bernardio members and Wessernian people to be crushed, Hatzur had taken off in his helicopter leaving behind the bodies of several of his generals, and the Council of 13 were sitting above it all ,watching in utter shock and horror as a terrorist hellbent on making Western View the Valmornian "empire" again. This was even worse on the ground. The gruesome and grafic scene could not be imagined by any sane person. Blood everywhere, people screaming, for others, for help, for justice, for death, it truly was the worst day in Wessernain history. Thinking in the moment John Fredrickson asked for live feed of the top floor of the Skile Crov (Sky Crown). Anyone who was near an intact device that could produce media were able to hear/see their Head Council. zhe said things that will live in infamy, "If we die we die as one, if we fight we fight as one, and if we live...we live as ourselves. Hatzur can't take that away because we won't let him, so stand and fight, for our country, for our land, and for our identity as a person!" A shot yet impactful speech that will live for eons to come, and resulted in the greatest [u]modern[/u] military win in Wessernian history. Hatzur went from controling 2/3 of the island to a single general who was left for dead because he was unconscious.

[b][i]23:13[/i][/b]

It was the exact same time the SS Leviathan was last heard from 1 year ago. It was now the exact time when Hatzur's retreating ships were caught limping away towards Elsyer by superior Wessernian forces and Balladullahian forces. Special operation teams raided each ship until, at 23:13, they found him with a flask of cyanide, guns, ammunition, and his inner circle of generals. He tried to open the cyanide flask but failed because he was restrained by those who had entered the room only seconds before. At around 23:46 Hatzur was pulled out of the ships interior, albeit a little forcefully for he struggled very much to no avail. The press had soon surrounded the brigade bringing him back to Western View, and were there up until he entered solitary confinement for the death penalty had been outlawed only days before the attack.

[b][i][u]A bit After[/u][/i][/b]

Money had been given to Baladullah in their efforts to apprehend Hatzur and for extra compensation for any damage Hatzur had done. Unfortunately Guhui'Bernardio has not been eradicated completely and, hopefully will be fully gone soon. The total number of dead from Hatzur Zatsugi is unknown, but estimates go as far as the millions. Hatzur official sentence is as follows:
Life in solitary confinement with no access whatsoever to the outside world. People who enter are under strict security and where he is held is unknown be the general public (deep under the seafloor about 7 kilometers away from the island, and thus many many many kilometers away from any "mainland"). The press has been unable to get the full details but them and other media outlets, have been booming, John Fredrickson has proven to be a great peacetime Head Council, and so far Western View has been able to clean up a lot. A monument has been erected in the entrance to the Horxciv Collex (Horizon Complex) it will stand to the right of the monument in the middle that remembers the end of the Wessernian Revolution (dispatch about those wars coming soon) with the opposite side having a monument to the Wessernian-Valmornian wars (dispatch about that also coming soon). Along with the monument the Wessernian History Museum (constructed by Harlem Shulyia, succceeded by Tony Messiaon) has been renamed the Tony Messiaon Museum. The Monument Garden has also been created just to the side of the entrance to the Horxciv Collex (technically it's on main street because main street leads right into the Horxciv Collex). About 2 days after interrogations of Hatzur Zatsugi ends he takes his life by suffocating himself, his casket is paraded around the streets of Western View as people celebrate, throws rotten food at the casket and fire fireworks in the air. He is burried in a "temple", really just a slab of glorified concrete, on the outskirts of Wessernia, his coffin is left in the open air for people to shame. It is also said that if you put a picture of someone you hate or got into an argument with near the coffin you will be relieved of any anger towards them.[/spoiler] OOC: When i first went to write John Fredrickson's famous words i was going to put "You shall not pass!" bc youtube, i mean unknown streaming platform, kept giving me memes related to gandalf's words.

[Spoiler=Second Taultion Bombing]
Monday, October 12th, 2026. People travel to Centre City Taultion to pay respects and mourn the loses of those lost their lives in the terrorist attack on the Daniel B. Foster Tower fourteen months prior at a newly opened memorial. A dark day in Lamandican history as an estimated 400 spend their lunch break remembering the event. While they air their grievances, an unmarked white van pulls to a stop on Heptwell Street. The van stays for a few minutes parked before a command to fire was reportedly yelled from inside the vehicle. Doors swing open. Men in black vests and face coverings jump out, grenades and makeshift bombs in hand. Just as they came out, the noise of metal hitting the ground comes from the memorial. BANG! Just like half a year ago, an explosion rings out in the center of Taultion, at the same location. The men, now armed with assault rifles, start firing into the now frightened, pale, fleeing, innocent civilians, while more bombs are thrown into the crowd. After thirty seconds of this, the men file back into the vehicle, but they were not done just yet. The men drive the van into the memorial, running over the injured in the way. They stop to the plaque with all the victims names from the terrorist bombing six months ago when one man gets out. Screaming, crying, sirens fill the lunchtime in Taultion. Many strong words were heard, but only the sprayed-on ones of the 8/1 Victims Memorial weighed the most: GUHUIBERNARDIO, IT IS NOW! RECKONING IS UPON! [/spoiler]

[Spoiler=Raid At WMW Wichenvidence]
While news of the chaos in Taultion just started to spread across Lamandica, workers at the WMW factory outside of Wichenvidence were working on the finishing touches to the biggest project in the history of the Lamandican Navy. WMW, but mostly the work of various other corporations have worked together on an all new, state-of-the-art fleet of warships, spearheaded by KLNN Titus. While word of the tragedy in Taultion started to get to the factory, men dressed in black uniforms entered the WMW Campus brandishing AR-15s. They started firing at factory workers, catching them off guard. Both sides started to get in tanks and grab weapons. A battle reportedly unfolded in the factory. A chaotic mess that when it was over, left the WMW campus in ruins. Though various outbuildings still remain standing, the main assembly plant reduced to rubble. The Wichenvidence Constabulary, Odrenisus Province Motorway Patrol, and various search and rescue corporations have started looking for any survivors, but have to be vigilant if another ambush were to occur. This story is still developing. Prime Minister Juan Sorobzaul Calieno-Ruiz still has yet to address the nation after a day of terror for Lamandica. [/spoiler]
